signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office

bullets: Set priorities for the theater tier, make the trade-offs, and defend them to engineering, leadership, and the customer in a way that earns trust.
Decide what we build and, just as importantly, what we say no to, keeping the focus on the decisions that shape theater-wide sustainment.
Turn an ambitious multi-echelon vision into a sequenced roadmap with clear priorities, dependencies, and success metrics, balancing near-term customer needs with long-term product…
